cross_agent_request_reply.summary: Repowire bridge handles ask frames and bridge-reply sends ack/answer callbacks.

dirty_work_refusal.summary: close --archive refuses dirty git repositories unless --preserve-dirty is explicit.

human_visibility_takeover.summary: Workers are cdesktop workspaces/sessions; message and closeout commands route visible follow-ups.

install_uninstall_containment.summary: service install/uninstall is contained to user LaunchAgents and ~/.local/state logs, but it mutates user launchd state so runtime install is blocked.

isolated_worktrees.summary: spawn requires explicit --worktree/--direct and passes use_worktree into cdesktop.

commands.stdout:
usage: agent-deck [-h] [--url URL] [--json]
                  {doctor,list,configure,spawn,message,teammate-spawn,teammate-list,close,service,bridge,bridge-route,bridge-reply} ...

positional arguments:
  {doctor,list,configure,spawn,message,teammate-spawn,teammate-list,close,service,bridge,bridge-route,bridge-reply}
    doctor              Verify local orchestration dependencies
    list                List cdesktop workspaces and sessions
    configure           Enforce local-only cdesktop settings
    spawn               Launch a full visible cdesktop workspace
    message             Send a visible cdesktop follow-up
    teammate-spawn      Launch a visible same-workspace teammate
    teammate-list       List the caller's cdesktop team
    close               Request closeout or archive reconciled work
    service             Manage the local cdesktop service
    bridge              Bridge enabled cdesktop sessions into Repowire
    bridge-route        Enable or disable Repowire routing
    bridge-reply        Reply to a bridged Repowire ask

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL             Exact local cdesktop backend URL
  --json                Emit JSON
